#define ACCESSORS_RELAXED_CHECKED2(holder, name, type, offset, get_condition, \
                                   set_condition)                             \
  type holder::name() const {                                                 \
    PtrComprCageBase cage_base = GetPtrComprCageBase(*this);                  \
    return holder::name(cage_base);                                           \
  }                                                                           \
  type holder::name(PtrComprCageBase cage_base) const {                       \
    type value = TaggedField<type, offset>::Relaxed_Load(cage_base, *this);   \
    DCHECK(get_condition);                                                    \
    return value;                                                             \
  }                                                                           \
  void holder::set_##name(type value, WriteBarrierMode mode) {                \
    DCHECK(set_condition);                                                    \
    TaggedField<type, offset>::Relaxed_Store(*this, value);                   \
    CONDITIONAL_WRITE_BARRIER(*this, offset, value, mode);                    \
  }

conclusions: ErrorStackData holds exactly one tagged call_site_infos_or_formatted_stack union, plus an independent detailed StackTraceInfo. HasFormattedStack is !IsFixedArray; the formatted setter directly stores to the same field with the normal write barrier. Formatting does not keep a second permanent simple array in that record.

GetErrorStackProperty starts at the actual receiver and walks the prototype chain skipping interceptors; GetDataProperty never calls a proxy/getter. A blocked accessor/proxy/Wasm/denied-access lookup returns not-found; data, including formatted undefined, terminates the lookup. The returned holder is the actual object storing the private symbol.

GetSimpleStackTrace returns an existing FixedArray, or ErrorStackData.call_site_infos only while that union is still FixedArray; otherwise it returns the canonical empty array. GetDetailedStackTrace only accepts ErrorStackData and returns its separate detailed trace regardless of the formatted union.
GetFormattedStack passes the selected holder, not the original inherited receiver, to FormatStackTrace. SetFormattedStack likewise updates that holder and is a no-op when none exists.

FormatStackTrace receives a DirectHandle raw_stack and casts another elems handle before any prepareStackTrace getter, callback, error string conversion or per-frame formatting. These local roots preserve the old CallSiteInfos array during a reentrant stack setter; GetStackFrames additionally creates actual callsite objects retaining individual CallSiteInfo entries.

On successful formatting, the ErrorStackData branch mutates the selected old ErrorStackData record's union; it does not redo lookup or reinstall it. The raw FixedArray branch performs Object::SetProperty on the selected holder. An ordinary setter's intermediate formatted value is overwritten after success; if reentry replaces the entire private record, these branch-specific operations must be preserved. If formatting throws, the final assignment is skipped and any actual setter-selected state remains.

Detailed capture is optional. Isolate capture can store undefined or a simple FixedArray directly, or an ErrorStackData pair when uncaught detailed capture is enabled. Detailed construction skips un-debuggable frames and stops at an async callsite; it may be independently captured when simple capture is absent or cross-origin frames are requested.

CreateMessage tries explicit exception positions, then surviving simple frames, then the current debuggable stack. If all fail there is a genuine no-location result. MakeMessageObject retains start/end/bytecode -1 and the intrinsic empty Script; it does not fabricate coordinates from a formatted string or historical frame record.
limits: Source-only immutable def0 proof; no Message/C/Engine implementation or execution.
The standard public formatted stack and the separate native captured-frame diagnostics owner are not equated.
This proof establishes storage/lookup/formatter lifetime and location selection, not the still separate reporter/catcher/termination composition.
